data.name: Geethika
data.gender_notes: Geethika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Geethika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Geetha’, which means a song or melody. The name signifies the rhythm and harmony in life and is often associated with spiritual wisdom and knowledge. The name is also connected to the Hindu epic Mahabharata, where Geetha is the name of the chariot driver of Arjuna. The Bhagavad Gita, a sacred text in Hinduism, is conveyed to Arjuna by Lord Krishna while they are on a battlefield. Geetha thus embodies the harmony and balance that exists within us, guiding us to make the right decisions.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of harmony and balance, guiding us to make the right decisions.
data.etymology: Geethika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Song, Melody.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Geethika total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
